name: How much does it cost to fix cold air coming through windows?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to fix cold air coming through windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix cold air coming through windows varies widely based on the repair method. DIY solutions like caulk or weatherstripping kits can be under $50 per window. Professional recaulking and weatherstripping might range from $75 to $250 per window, depending on access and materials. If the issue necessitates full window replacement, costs can be significantly higher, starting from a few hundred dollars to over a thousand per window, depending on the type, material, and installation complexity. A professional estimate is crucial for accurate pricing.
